definitions.gloss: Western calendar, Christian Era, Common Era
definitions.explanation: The calendar system based on years counted from the traditional birth year of Jesus Christ; the Gregorian calendar dating system.

examples.japanese: {西暦|せいれき}2024{年|ねん}は{令和|れいわ}6{年|ねん}です。
{書類|しょるい}には{西暦|せいれき}で{日付|ひづけ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write the date using the Western calendar on the documents.

examples.japanese: {西暦|せいれき}と{和暦|われき}、どちらで{書|か}けばいいですか。
examples.english: Should I write it in the Western calendar or Japanese era?

notes:
Japan uses two calendar systems: {西暦|せいれき} (Western/Gregorian calendar) and {和暦|われき} (Japanese era calendar based on imperial reigns).

CALENDAR SYSTEMS IN JAPAN:
- {西暦|せいれき}: Western calendar (2024, 2025, etc.)
- {和暦|われき}: Japanese era calendar ({令和|れいわ}, {平成|へいせい}, {昭和|しょうわ}, etc.)

USAGE:
- International contexts, business, younger generations often prefer {西暦|せいれき}
- Government documents, traditional contexts often use {和暦|われき}
- Many forms accept either

ABBREVIATIONS:
- A.D. / C.E. correspond to {西暦|せいれき} (though B.C./B.C.E. would be {紀元前|きげんぜん})
